changelog:
The presence preview now shows what Discord actually draws on a profile — the poster, the title, your detail lines and the live "elapsed / total" progress bar — instead of a full fake profile wrapped around it.
The old profile scaffolding (banner, avatar cluster, Edit Profile buttons, tabs, Member Since, Moderator Actions, note card) had no caller left after the preview became card-only, so it is removed from the build rather than shipped as unreachable code: about 27 KB smaller plugin, nothing reachable changed.
Long Discord display names are no longer clipped in the account row — the name and handle now shorten with an ellipsis instead of running under the sign-out button.
message: Dev build v866 - RPC preview is the real card, dead profile code removed
